release.notes: DEV TEST ONLY — Build 15.10.5: refreshed Score Studio interface with premium charcoal-and-gold cards, compact score-sound controls, highlighted audio source selection, live volume label, five editable score-message brackets, fixed Save/Close footer, and D-pad focus support. Retains early MIDI/KAR lyrics preview and custom MP3/WAV/OGG sound import from the previous Developer build. Scoring algorithm and Stable/Beta channels unchanged.
